item.title: Work from Home cannot give parent an upper hand regarding child custody matters: Supreme Court
item.description: The Court stated that with working parents, it is expected that they cannot always be physically with their children, however, this cannot be a ground to place the child’s custody with the parent who may be temporarily working from home. The post Work from Home cannot give parent an upper hand regarding child custody matters: Supreme Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Punjab and Haryana High Court quashes FIR against AAP leaders in protest over Lakhimpur Kheri incident
item.description: “In the absence of any allegation of commission of the offences by an unlawful assembly, as chargesheet has not been filed under Sections 147 as 147 and 149 of the IPC, the petitioners cannot be held liable for the alleged acts of causing hurt or assault by any of the protestors, even if the allegations are accepted of accepted as true.” The post Punjab and Haryana High Court quashes FIR against AAP leaders in protest over Lakhimpur Kheri incident appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Justice J.S. Verma Fellowship Scheme: Opportunities for Young Advocates
item.description: To identify and support promising young advocates in Supreme Court litigation, the Supreme Court Lawyers Welfare Trust has instituted the Justice J.S. Verma Fellowships. The post Justice J.S. Verma Fellowship Scheme: Opportunities for Young Advocates appeared first on SCC Times.

item.description: Updated and expanded by V. Sudhish Pai, bringing doctrinal depth, contemporary insight, and a renewed understanding of constitutional principles. The post A classic reborn: T.K. Tope’s Constitutional Law of India appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas successfully represented Coinswitch in a domain name dispute concerning an impugned domain before the WIPO UDRP Panel
item.description: The Panel upheld Coinswitch’s claim on all three UDRP criteria, finding confusing similarity, lack of legitimate rights, and bad faith registration and use. The post Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas successfully represented Coinswitch in a domain name dispute concerning an impugned domain before the WIPO UDRP Panel appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Most unfortunate incident; police can’t act strongly with lawyers: Rajasthan High Court directs soft skill training for police officials
item.description: The incident, which has been recorded in a video, has become viral, reflects that the SHO has misbehaved and manhandled the lawyer who was representing the cause of victim. The post Most unfortunate incident; police can’t act strongly with lawyers: Rajasthan High Court directs soft skill training for police officials appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Status quo order cannot hinder flood mitigation; Eco Park and ponds conceived in larger public interest: Madras High Court
item.description: “It is necessary to reiterate the grave concerns surrounding air pollution and AQI levels, the reduction of which forms a central part of the rationale behind the Eco Park, since air pollution today is not merely an environmental issue, it has become a public health emergency.” The post Status quo order cannot hinder flood mitigation; Eco Park and ponds conceived in larger public interest: Madras High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: BCI must construe existing framework to ensure 30% seats in State Bar Council are occupied by women members: Supreme Court
item.description: The Court directed that the complete details by the Bar Council of India to be furnished on 08-12-2025; and clarified that the relevant Rules shall be deemed to have been amended providing making a provision for such reservation. The post BCI must construe existing framework to ensure 30% seats in State Bar Council are occupied by women members: Supreme Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.description: DSNLU Visakhapatnam announces the 2nd Vis Pre Moot 2026, offering law students rigorous training in international arbitration with SIAC and Jus Mundi as partners.
